summary: Novu provides notification infrastructure designed for developers to manage and dispatch user alerts. It centralises messaging workflows across multiple channels through a unified backend system.
goodFor: Development teams building applications that require complex multi-channel alert routing and template management.
watchOut: Self-hosting involves running a Node.js-based stack with multiple dependent services, which can introduce significant operational and resource overhead.
deployNotes: You will typically need to run this via Docker alongside a persistent database and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
